protocol.policy: Use the published Load Choice opening and blind freight policy. With one slot left after a purchase, when its informed policy would pass an offer its blind policy would book, learn whether to take the signed offer now. Fit the net value of purchasing after this change. Other freight decisions follow the previous checkpoint.
protocol.markets: Freeze eight new paired openings, sharing their first five waves across endings, without using economic outcomes. On both target markets half of the schedules have a sixth-wave move that points away from the ending. Preserve all freight and survey dynamics, prices, independent planner, and the exact original interrupted drop. Archive the preceding Load Choice test schedules on independent seeds.
protocol.fitting: Estimate the signed credit difference and downside of waiting using sampled training outcomes, and train a gate on a separate bank. Use disjoint fitting and training-only selection seeds, the public observation at the time of the decision and a fixed selection grid in fit.mjs. Fit all five checkpoints before public scoring and publish training seed 13.
protocol.primary: Fresh cold-ending reversals require positive lower paired 95% bounds against both the identical always-skip learner and the independent fee-aware planner. Preserving the hot-drop win requires a positive lower bound against the planner on fresh hot-ending drops. Report hot drops versus skipping and the previous hot schedules separately. Average across six equally weighted positive prices, including every offered shift. The joint test requires these three fresh comparisons and original-drop retention.
protocol.retention: Across seven prices on the original interrupted-drop schedule, require positive lower bounds vs stochastic planner, Booking and Survey; require lower bounds above minus one credit vs Load Choice, Last Slot, Tariff, Paid, Rally, Trust, Drift and Turns. Report the current price-aware planner separately.
protocol.matched: For the common one-slot cohort, give the learned, always-skip and price-aware planner continuations the identical balance and observed history from the historical Tariff opener. Include every one-slot gate regardless of the purchase.
protocol.loadChoice: Compare actual purchases and all forced purchases with blind and unguarded freight on identical tapes. Record the booked wave in all three branches (zero for an empty slot). A harmful wait books later than blind for lower gross freight. A beneficial wait books later for higher gross freight. Isolate the stopping rule by holding gate and fee fixed while replacing guarded bookings with the unguarded Load Choice continuation. Compare the trained rule with a blanket stop on every eligible disagreement at the identical gate. Report opportunities, worthwhile stops, missed savings, beneficial and costly overrides, and net returns after fees. Worked examples use fixed manifest order within each outcome class and prefer actual paid cases.
protocol.uncertainty: Pair shifts across policies. Use 2,000 paired percentile-bootstrap draws resampling complete seeds with their sibling schedules and fees. Report the free control, all four endings, five training runs and prior market archive without selecting a checkpoint on those results.
